intro: Gold and cotton are Burkina Faso's main exports.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Gold mining has boomed since the 2000s. Cotton, shea nuts and sesame are big crops, and most people are subsistence farmers.

chapters.title: Shea
text: Women's groups make shea butter for cosmetics sold worldwide.

keyTerms.meaning: Growing food mainly for your own family.

cardGroups.title: Made in Burkina Faso
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Burkina Faso makes and sells to the world.
